rows.note: Use 面色 as the all-purpose choice for the visible colour or condition of someone’s facial skin.

example.english: Your complexion looks pretty good today.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 min6 sik1 gei2 hou2 wo3

rows.note: Use 膚色 specifically for a person’s natural skin tone or colour, not their overall facial condition.

example.english: Their complexion is on the darker side.
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 fu1 sik1 pin1 sam1

rows.note: Use 外觀 for the outward appearance of an object, place, or other thing rather than facial skin.

example.english: This building has a fairly modern complexion.
example.jyutping: ni1 dung6 lau4 ngoi6 gun1 gei2 jin6 doi6
